title: Define calibration draft states
description: Define a versioned, serializable CalibrationDraft state machine covering layout selection, setup identification, configuration confirmation, artifact generation, plain-paper inspection, observation entry, diagnostics, and completion without creating a printer profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Every PRD 25 state and allowed next action has a stable serializable identifier
Draft data records schema version, identity, current state, references, diagnostics, and timestamps
Initial and terminal states do not imply physical validation or create a usable printer profile
Schema parsing refuses unknown states and malformed state-specific data

steps.details: Define discriminated serializable states and stable action identifiers for each PRD 25 workflow stage.
Add versioned draft identity, current state, exact references, artifact metadata, inspections, observations, diagnostics, and timestamps.
Map each state to explicit next actions while excluding profile derivation and correction application.
Round-trip every state and refuse unknown versions, unknown states, and incomplete state-specific payloads.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; define contracts and focused serialization tests only.
Completion means workflow completion, not physical calibration or profile validity.
